preconditions: Use the reviewed private-bundle deployment policy; no public GitHub network or push. Installation receipt must bind target SHA, policy SHA and bundle SHA. The current successful runtime/install/<target>/receipt.json remains the execution credential. The closeout owner may archive and remove only superseded receipt directories after they no longer authorize runs; failed actions retain evidence for diagnosis. Temporary bundle directories are tool-owned and removed automatically. The persistent runner-install.log is preserved.
